name: Wrakk the Harvester
bio: A mad botanist by his own admission, Wrakk built his battlesuit to catch those that would pilfer from his pumpkin patch. He lies in wait for potential squash thieves, hiding as a carved lantern, and gives them what for with his array of buzzsaws and bombs. Most would say it's overkill. Wrakk says they get off lightly.
